_about: Extra themes for individual roll calls, added to the parent item's themes. Key: date|doc_number|seq. 'starts' must match the start of the motion text, so a changed parse can't silently mis-tag. 'basis' says where the subject comes from (the motion text, or the amendment document on efiles.portlandoregon.gov).
